provenance.resolutionNote: Saving a quote draft is an internal product operation, not a legal act — same reasoning as fr.json/pl.json/be.json/nl.json/at.json/gr.json/hr.json for this same action: no Portuguese text identified that would specifically govern this act (the Código do IVA — CIVA — only speaks of « fatura », never of an « orçamento »/quote). To revisit if the product were ever to give legal effect to the mere fact of saving a draft.

provenance.sourceText: An electronic signature shall not be denied legal effect and admissibility as evidence in legal proceedings solely on the grounds that it is in an electronic form or that it does not meet the requirements for qualified electronic signatures.

rules.notes: Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 (eIDAS), art. 25 § 1 — READ DIRECTLY on 2026-09-04 at eur-lex.europa.eu (CELEX:32014R0910, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:32014R0910): HTTP 200, full page (613,377 bytes), citation found verbatim (fresh reading in this session, same direct-curl method as hr.json/gr.json/be.json — an EU regulation of direct applicability, invariant across countries). A quote is not a « fatura » within the meaning of the Código do IVA (CIVA): it is this general regime of non-discrimination of the electronic writing that grounds the sending of a quote, not the specifically tax-related regime developed below for invoice.send.

provenance.resolutionNote: Converting an accepted quote into an invoice is a product convenience; no Portuguese text identified imposes or forbids this precise mechanism. The only legal constraint bears on THE INVOICE that will result from it (see invoice.save-draft/invoice.send below), never on this prior act of conversion from a quote.

Requesting a deposit on a quote, in the form of a draft deposit invoice, is a product convenience of the same nature as 'convert-to-invoice' above; no Portuguese text identified governs this precise mechanism. CIVA art. 29.º n.º 1 alínea b) (read in the primary source on 2026-09-04, see invoice.send below) DOES IMPOSE the issuance of a fatura for any payment received before delivery/performance (« bem como pelos pagamentos que lhes sejam efetuados antes da data da transmissão de bens ou da prestação de serviços ») — but this bears on the deposit invoice ONCE issued, never on this prior act of requesting it from a quote still in draft.

Generating a billing schedule from an accepted quote (several draft invoices, one per installment) is a product convenience of the same nature as 'request-deposit' above; no Portuguese text identified governs this precise mechanism. The only legal constraint bears on THE INVOICES that will result from it once issued (see invoice.save-draft/invoice.send below, and CIVA art. 29.º n.º 1 alínea b) cited by 'request-deposit' above for any payment received in advance), never on this prior act of generation from a quote still in draft.
Duplicating a quote into a new draft is a pure product convenience; no Portuguese text identified governs it.

Generating an unauthenticated public link to a quote's PDF is a product convenience — a quote is not even a « fatura » within the meaning of the CIVA. No Portuguese text identified that would specifically govern the sharing of a link to a document already communicated to its recipient.

Asking a client to electronically sign a quote (link + OTP code by email — signatures/signatures.service.ts) is a product convenience — a quote is not even a « fatura » within the meaning of the CIVA, and signing a quote is not a legally regulated act, it is a mark of commercial acceptance. The mechanism stays at the lowest eIDAS level (SIMPLE electronic signature), never a certificate, so no Portuguese text on advanced/qualified electronic signature applies here. To be confirmed by a dedicated review if needed.

NO legal research was performed for this entry - unlike this rule's neighbors above, this note does not claim any text was read. Allowed because this action records an ISSUER-SIDE FACT ONLY - who marked a sent quote accepted, when, and by what means - and changes no fiscal fact and produces no document a third party ever receives, the same kind of internal record quote.duplicate above already sits on. WHAT WOULD SETTLE THIS: a text conditioning the evidentiary value, or the validity, of a quote's acceptance on the channel through which it was obtained - to be confirmed by a dedicated review before this record is relied on as a substitute for a legally regulated acceptance mechanism.

provenance.sourceText: As disposições dos artigos 36.º e seguintes devem ser observadas sempre que, emitida a fatura, o valor tributável de uma operação ou o respetivo imposto venham a sofrer retificação por qualquer motivo.

rules.notes: Código do IVA (CIVA, aprovado pelo Decreto-Lei n.º 394-B/84, texto consolidado tal como servido par l'Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira — AT), art. 78.º n.º 1 — READ DIRECTLY on 2026-09-04 at https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/informacao_fiscal/codigos_tributarios/civa_rep/Pages/iva78.aspx (static HTML page served by the AT itself — classic SharePoint, direct curl without JavaScript; the official domain diariodarepublica.pt, meanwhile, serves this same text behind an OutSystems React SPA with no public API found in this session — see the file-level note below for the complete access method). REINFORCED by art. 36.º n.º 6 (same index page, read the same day, https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/informacao_fiscal/codigos_tributarios/civa_rep/Pages/iva36.aspx): « As guias ou notas de devolução e outros documentos retificativos de faturas devem conter, além da data e numeração sequencial, os elementos a que se refere a alínea a) do número anterior, bem como a referência à fatura a que respeitam e as menções desta que são objeto de alterações » — a corrective document to a fatura MUST be a DATED document, SEPARATELY SEQUENTIALLY NUMBERED, referencing the initial fatura and the elements of it that are amended. MECHANISM, in the manner of FR/BE/GR/EE/HR but phrased PROCEDURALLY rather than through a frontal assimilation clause (« é considerada fatura »): Portuguese law never writes "any document that amends the initial invoice is deemed to be an invoice", but FUNCTIONALLY imposes the same result — once the fatura is ISSUED, any correction must go through a SEPARATE DOCUMENT, dated and numbered within its own sequence, never a silent re-issue of the original fatura (see credit-note.send below and correction-routes/data/pt.json's own CREDIT_NOTE/DEBIT_NOTE/CORRECTIVE_INVOICE, sourced to the same provisions) — hence `statuses: ["draft"]`, which blocks `save-draft` once the invoice is 'sent'. FURTHER REINFORCED by Decreto-Lei n.º 28/2019, de 15 de fevereiro (the invoicing regime itself, see invoice.send below), art. 7.º n.º 5: « As faturas e demais documentos fiscalmente relevantes processados através de programas informáticos ou outros meios eletrónicos devem ser obrigatoriamente registados em base de dados [...], evidenciando igualmente os documentos anulados » — a cancelled document must remain TRACKED in the log/database, never silently erased; and Portaria n.º 363/2010, de 23 de junho (as republished by Portaria n.º 340/2013, de 22 de novembro — technical certification text for invoicing programs), art. 3.º alínea d): the certified program must not « dispor de qualquer função que [...] permita alterar [...] a informação de natureza fiscal, sem gerar evidência agregada à informação original » (have NO function allowing the tax-relevant information to be altered without generating evidence appended to the original information) — three independent texts converge on the same post-issuance immutability requirement.

provenance.sourceText: Para efeitos do artigo anterior, os sujeitos passivos com sede, estabelecimento estável ou domicílio em território nacional e outros sujeitos passivos cuja obrigação de emissão de fatura se encontre sujeita às regras estabelecidas na legislação interna nos termos do artigo 35.º-A do Código do IVA, estão obrigados a utilizar, exclusivamente, programas informáticos que tenham sido objeto de prévia certificação pela AT, sempre que: a) Tenham tido, no ano civil anterior, um volume de negócios superior a € 50 000 ou, quando, no exercício em que se inicia a atividade, o período em referência seja inferior ao ano civil, e o volume de negócios anualizado relativo a esse período seja superior àquele montante; b) Utilizem programas informáticos de faturação; c) Sejam obrigados a dispor de contabilidade organizada ou por ela tenham optado.

rules.notes: EXPECTED FINDING OF THIS TASK — THE CERTIFIED INVOICING SOFTWARE REGIME, confirmed against the raw text, THREE distinct statutes read in the primary source on 2026-09-04, all served as static HTML/PDF by info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt (the portal of the Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira — AT): (1) Decreto-Lei n.º 28/2019, de 15 de fevereiro (« regime da fatura eletrónica » — overhaul and consolidation of the invoicing rules), art. 4.º n.º 1, quoted verbatim above — READ from the official PDF https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/informacao_fiscal/legislacao/diplomas_legislativos/Documents/Decreto_Lei_28_2019.pdf (25 pages, text extracted with pdftotext -layout, never a fetch-summary). Exact CUMULATIVE CONDITIONS (the text uses « sempre que : » followed by three items a/b/c, the same cumulative syntax as for any such list of conditions in the CIVA itself): national turnover of the preceding calendar year > EUR 50,000 (or prorated for a newly-started activity), AND use of an invoicing program, AND an obligation (or election) to keep organized accounting. For THIS product (Invoicerr, an invoicing SaaS NOT certified by the AT to date): a Portuguese client company crossing THESE THREE cumulative thresholds would be required, by this art. 4.º n.º 1, to use EXCLUSIVELY a program certified by the AT — which, as things stand, is NOT the case for this tool. This does not block the `invoice.send` action in THIS catalog (which documents rules product-by-product, not an overall compliance checklist) but it is the most operationally significant fact found by this task: to be handled as a separate compliance workstream (AT certification of the program), not as a button-level block. (2) Portaria n.º 195/2020, de 13 de agosto (implementing regulation for art. 7.º n.º 3 of the same Decreto-Lei n.º 28/2019) — READ IN FULL, official PDF https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/informacao_fiscal/legislacao/diplomas_legislativos/Documents/Portaria_195_2020.pdf, published in the Diário da República n.º 157/2020, Série I, páginas 13-15 — imposes the ATCUD (código único do documento) AND the código QR on EVERY fatura and tax-relevant document: art. 3.º (n.ºs 1 to 3) — RE-READ IN THE PRIMARY SOURCE on 2026-09-13, same official PDF (https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/informacao_fiscal/legislacao/diplomas_legislativos/Documents/Portaria_195_2020.pdf, direct curl, HTTP 200, 37,995 bytes, pdftotext -layout): « 1 - O código de validação da série a atribuir pela AT é composto por uma cadeia de carateres, com um comprimento mínimo de oito (8) carateres. 2 - O ATCUD é composto pela concatenação dos seguintes elementos, separados pelo carácter «-», sem aspas: a) Código de validação da série, como definido no n.º 1; b) O número sequencial do documento dentro da série. 3 - Para efeitos da alínea b) do número anterior, o número sequencial a utilizar é a sequência de caracteres numéricos, sendo que, no caso dos programas informáticos de faturação, é a que se encontra imediatamente a seguir à barra (/), tal como definido na estrutura de dados referida na Portaria n.º 321-A/2007, de 26 de março [...] » — STRUCTURAL FACT for implementing the ATCUD (to remember for whoever codes its generation, rather than re-deriving it): the código de validação is a string of AT LEAST 8 characters (no maximum stated by this text); the exact format of the ATCUD itself, restated at art. 4.º n.º 1 below, is «CodigodeValidação-NumeroSequencial» — A SINGLE separator DASH, no quotation marks; the sequential number is NOT a free product counter but IS the number of the document within its series as defined by the SAF-T (PT) data structure (Portaria n.º 321-A/2007, de 26 de março). art. 4.º n.º 1 (« O ATCUD, com o formato «ATCUD:CodigodeValidação-NumeroSequencial», deve constar obrigatoriamente em todas as faturas e outros documentos fiscalmente relevantes »), art. 2.º — RE-READ IN THE PRIMARY SOURCE on 2026-09-13, same official PDF — on the MECHANISM FOR OBTAINING the código de validação (the document series, not the taxpayer taken as a whole, is the unit communicated to the AT): « Para a obtenção do código de validação das séries documentais, previsto no n.º 2 do artigo 35.º do Decreto-Lei n.º 28/2019, de 15 de fevereiro, os sujeitos passivos devem comunicar, nos termos do n.º 1 do mesmo artigo, por meio de processamento utilizado, como forma de identificação da série: a) O identificador da série do documento; b) O tipo de documento, de acordo com as tipologias documentais definidas na estrutura de dados a que se refere a Portaria n.º 321-A/2007 [...]; c) O início da numeração sequencial a utilizar na série [...]; d) A data prevista de início da utilização da série para a qual é solicitado o código de validação. » — REINFORCED AND MADE OPERATIONAL by the AT's own official FAQ (primary source: operational guidance from the tax administration, static SharePoint HTML page, direct curl without JavaScript, HTTP 200), « Outras Obrigações > Séries/ATCUD > Âmbito de Aplicação », items 4302-4318, https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/apoio_contribuinte/questoes_frequentes/Pages/faqs-00883.aspx, READ on 2026-09-13: FACT — the código de validação is obtained PER PAIR (series identifier × document type), never a single one per taxpayer nor a single one per series taken alone (FAQ 4312): « 4312 - O código de validação a atribuir à serie pode ser apenas um por cada identificador de série para os diferentes tipos de documento? Não. O código de validação a atribuir à serie é específico para cada conjunto composto pelo identificador de série e pelo tipo de documento. » FACT — it MUST be associated with the series BEFORE any document of that series is issued (FAQ 4308): « 4308 - Quando devo comunicar uma série para obter o código de validação? Quanto tempo demora a obter o código por parte da AT? A série deve ser comunicada para obtenção do respetivo código de validação antes do início de utilização da série. A AT disponibilizará o código de validação da série logo após a comunicação da respetiva série. Independentemente do meio de processamento utilizado, o código de validação tem de ser associado à respetiva série antes da emissão de documentos. » NOT VERIFIED by this reading: whether a machine-to-machine web service exists for this communication (the FAQ confirms a self-service flow via the Portal das Finanças and near-immediate delivery « logo após », but not explicitly an automatable API distinct from a web form — to be verified separately before automating this communication). art. 5.º (express reference to the technical specifications of the código QR, « a disponibilizar no Portal das Finanças » by the AT itself) and art. 6.º (placement of the QR on the document): a field table for the código QR CIRCULATES under the title « Especificações Técnicas — Código de Barras Bidimensional — Código QR », Versão 1.0, Agosto 2020, but COULD NOT BE FOUND, as of 2026-09-13, EXCEPT via a third-party mirror (a Portuguese accounting-software vendor, https://www.audico.pt/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/Especificacoes_Tecnicas_Codigo_QR.pdf): every URL attempted under the official domain info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt (including the historical path .../Novas_regras_faturacao/Documents/Especificacoes_Tecnicas_Codigo_QR.pdf and several case variants) returns HTTP 404. FOR LACK of confirmation from the AT's own domain or a second independent source, this field table IS NOT encoded here as a 'legal' fact — in line with this module's own provenance discipline (country-policy/schema.ts): a source not verified from the authority itself remains 'unverified', never promoted to the rank of a sourced fact on the sole strength of a mirror. To be re-established if the AT republishes this document under a verifiable URL, or if written confirmation from the AT/OCC (Ordem dos Contabilistas Certificados) is obtained. SCOPE DISTINCTION, established by the AT's own official FAQ (item 4307, same page and method as above, READ on 2026-09-13) — DECISIVE FOR THIS PRODUCT, WHICH IS NOT CERTIFIED BY THE AT: « As faturas e demais documentos fiscalmente relevantes emitidos por qualquer meio de processamento como, por exemplo, as máquinas registadoras, têm de exibir o código único de documento (ATCUD), devendo ser inserido pelo respetivo programa ou equipamento, independentemente do volume de negócios ou regime de tributação do emitente. O código QR apenas é exigível a documentos emitidos por programas informáticos de faturação certificados. » OPERATIONAL CONSEQUENCE: the ATCUD obligation applies to this product AS OF TODAY, whether or not it is certified by the AT (see the certification regime cited just above, at point (1)); the código QR obligation, on the other hand, ONLY applies if/when this product itself became a certified program — it is therefore an obligation TO BE DEFERRED, as opposed to the ATCUD, which is a workstream to handle now. art. 8.º (entry into force: 1 January 2021, transitional regime from 1 December 2020 for communicating series already in use) — THIS DATE OF 1 JANUARY 2021 ALONE IS MISLEADING IF PRESENTED AS THE DATE THE ATCUD OBLIGATION TOOK EFFECT: it never was. Despacho n.º 351/2021-XXII, do Secretário de Estado Adjunto e dos Assuntos Fiscais, de 10 de novembro de 2021, alínea e) — READ IN THE PRIMARY SOURCE on 2026-09-13, official signed PDF, hosted by the AT itself, https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/informacao_fiscal/legislacao/Despachos_SEAF/Documents/Despacho_SEAAF_351_2021_XXII.pdf (direct curl, HTTP 200, 608,239 bytes; scanned/signed document, imperfect OCR around the header but the alínea e) quoted below is clean) — SUSPENDED the obligation for the whole of 2022: « Em 2022 fique suspensa, quanto à comunicação de séries e à obrigação de aposição do código único de documento (ATCUD), a obrigatoriedade do disposto no n.º 3 do artigo 7.º e no artigo 35.º do Decreto-Lei n.º 28/2019, de 15 de fevereiro, na sua redação atual, sendo a aposição do ATCUD em todas as faturas e outros documentos fiscalmente relevantes considerada facultativa; » ACTUAL AND APPLIED EFFECTIVE DATE OF THE ATCUD OBLIGATION: 1 JANUARY 2023 (the mention becomes mandatory again upon expiry of this one-year suspension). HONEST CAVEAT, not to be hidden: this reading examined only ONE SINGLE despacho (this one); it DID NOT carry out an exhaustive search of every SEAAF despacho published between late 2021 and today that could have touched this date again. The trade press (secondary source, not verified in the primary source here) is unanimous that 1 January 2023 is the definitive date still in force, but this specific point IS NOT established here with the same rigor as the rest of this note — to be confirmed by a dedicated search of the 2022-2026 SEAAF despachos before relying on it absolutely. (3) Portaria n.º 363/2010, de 23 de junho (« Republicado pela Portaria n.º 340/2013, de 22 de novembro » — technical certification text, whose original art. 1.º and 2.º were EXPRESSLY revoked by Decreto-Lei n.º 28/2019 itself, the legal basis of the obligation having migrated to its own art. 4.º above, BUT whose art. 3.º/4.º/5.º/6.º/7.º — the TECHNICAL certification requirements — remain in force, « Estado: vigente » per the AT's own header) — READ IN FULL, official PDF https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/informacao_fiscal/legislacao/diplomas_legislativos/Documents/Portaria_363_2010.pdf: art. 6.º n.º 1 imposes an identification system using an RSA algorithm (asymmetric encryption) signing, for each document, the CONCATENATION of (a) the document date, (b) the recording date-time, (c) the document number, (d) the total amount, AND (e) « A assinatura gerada no documento anterior, do mesmo tipo e série de documento » — THE SIGNATURE GENERATED ON THE PRECEDING DOCUMENT, OF THE SAME TYPE AND SERIES — THIS IS THE CHAINED SIGNATURE announced by this task's brief: each document cryptographically embeds the signature of its immediate predecessor in the series, making any after-the-fact insertion or deletion detectable. Art. 6.º n.º 3 alínea a) requires printing 4 characters of this signature on the document (positions 1, 11, 21 and 31, separated by a dash) — exactly the « 4-char Hash » already anticipated by the pre-existing product documentation (documentation/compliance/PT-Portugal.md, a document not sourced prior to this task, now confirmed against the primary text). Art. 7.º extends this same signature mechanism to transport documents. THIS CHAINED SIGNATURE MECHANISM, like the certification regime itself, applies to the CERTIFIED PROGRAM (a technical requirement of the software), not to this `invoice.send` product action as such — but it is the EXACT technical counterpart of the immutability already documented by invoice.save-draft above. SEPARATE NUANCE, not conditioned on the certification threshold above: CIVA art. 36.º n.º 10 (read the same day, same page as invoice.save-draft) — « As faturas podem, sob reserva de aceitação pelo destinatário, ser emitidas por via eletrónica. » — the same recipient-CONSENT regime as FR/BE/NL/AT/GR/HR (outside a B2B mandate), applying to EVERY electronic fatura, certified or not. B2G (CIUS-PT): OUT OF SCOPE for this rule and this agent — already audited (2026-09-02): PT remains 'not deliverable' (CIUS-PT not vendorable, assorted third-party portals, no mention of Peppol on the EC factsheet); this task found nothing that would change this verdict.

provenance.resolutionNote: Duplicating an invoice into a new draft is the same pure product convenience as quote.duplicate above — the new document is born 'draft' and goes entirely back through the normal issuance circuit (new series/numbering, new ATCUD). No Portuguese text identified governs the act of duplication itself.

Recording a payment is an entry internal to the tool; no specific Portuguese text identified governs the mere fact of declaring it in this tool. ADJACENT NUANCE found and honestly documented, not to be confused with the above: Decreto-Lei n.º 28/2019, art. 9.º (« Emissão de recibos para efeitos de imposto sobre o rendimento das pessoas singulares »), read on 2026-09-04 on the same PDF as invoice.send, provides: « O disposto no presente decreto-lei não prejudica a obrigação de emissão de recibo, nos termos do Código do IRS, por parte dos titulares de rendimentos da categoria B. » — a Portuguese self-employed worker (rendimentos categoria B, the « recibos verdes » regime) has a SEPARATE obligation to issue a RECEIPT (recibo, via the e-fatura system) at the moment of actual payment — an INCOME TAX (IRS) obligation, separate from the VAT fatura itself, and which therefore does not bear on this precise mechanism of recording a payment IN this tool for a client company. Not researched further (out of scope for this task, which covers immutability/sending/credit notes).

EN 16931 is NOT the relevant format for Portugal outside of B2G (see below): the format actually established by Portuguese law is the SAF-T (PT) (Standard Audit File for Tax — Portaria n.º 321-A/2007, de 26 de março, reworked by Portaria n.º 1192/2009 then Portaria n.º 302/2016 for its current XML structure), a MONTHLY TRANSMISSION XML file TO THE AT (declarative, not document-by-document), distinct from an « export this invoice to XML » button from the tool — this precise product action therefore has no identified legal basis that would impose or specifically govern it. For B2G (CIUS-PT, UBL 2.1): already audited (2026-09-02) — PT 'not deliverable' (CIUS-PT not vendorable); this task found nothing that would change this verdict, and this file therefore models none of its aspects.

Exporting an invoice to an accounting tool is a product convenience; no specific Portuguese text identified governs the mere fact of offering this export. This action has no registered implementation to date anyway (see invoice-actions.ts) — the real block comes from the 501, not from this rule.

Generating an unauthenticated public link to an invoice's PDF is a product convenience; no Portuguese text identified specifically imposes or forbids sharing a link to an invoice already communicated to its legitimate recipient. The security of the link is a technical guarantee documented in share-links/share-links.service.ts, not a separate legal requirement to be sourced here.

Saving a credit-note draft is an internal product operation. The Portuguese legal regime for the regularização (see credit-note.send below and correction-routes/data/pt.json's own CREDIT_NOTE) concerns the TAX EFFECT of the document once issued, not the act of saving a draft — same distinction as fr.json/pl.json/nl.json/be.json/gr.json/hr.json for this same action.

Moving a credit note from 'draft' to 'sent' in this tool is an internal product mechanism (no transmission, no email is triggered by this action) — the same methodical distinction that hr.json/nl.json/be.json/gr.json already apply to their own credit-note.send. THE SUBSTANTIVE LEGAL BASIS, however, is real and documented: CIVA art. 78.º n.º 2 (« pode efectuar a dedução do correspondente imposto ») and n.º 3 (« é facultativa, quando houver imposto liquidado a mais, mas apenas pode ser efectuada no prazo de dois anos ») — an OPTION, not an obligation, to reduce the taxable base in the event of cancellation/reduction/return of goods/rebate, conditioned by n.º 5 on proof that the buyer became aware of the correction or was reimbursed. Portuguese law names NO dedicated instrument called « nota de crédito » at this stage (unlike Poland, art. 106j): see correction-routes/data/pt.json's own CREDIT_NOTE for the complete legal characterization — this rule concerns only the PRODUCT ACTION (this tool's 'send' button), never the legal regime of the document itself.

rules.notes: See correction-routes/data/pt.json's own CREDIT_NOTE (routeId, status 'allowed', provenance 'legal') for the complete legal characterization of the tax-base-reduction mechanism.

provenance.resolutionNote: Same reasoning as invoice.share-link above, applied to the credit note: no Portuguese text identified specifically governs the sharing of a public link to a credit note already communicated to its recipient.

rules.notes: Issue #472. CIVA art. 36.º n.º 6, re-read on info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt (civa_rep/Pages/iva36.aspx) on 2026-09-27, the text this file's own credit-note `numbering` fact already quotes. The EN 16931 export carries what it asks of a correcting document: its own date and number (BT-2, BT-1) and « a referência à fatura a que respeitam » (BG-3). Same scope as invoice.download-xml above: a voluntary EN 16931 export, not the format Portuguese law establishes. WHAT PORTUGAL NEEDS BEYOND THE EN 16931 EXPORT (issue #497): (1) in SAF-T (PT) a credit note is its own document type, `InvoiceType` NC: Portaria n.º 302/2016, field 4.1.4.8, « "NC" – Nota de crédito », now read first-hand on the AT's own copy of the Portaria (info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/informacao_fiscal/legislacao/diplomas_legislativos/Documents/Portaria_302_2016.pdf, 2026-09-28), replacing the GitHub mirror of SAFTPT1.04_01.xsd this note first cited; the AT's e-Fatura webservice manual (field 1.6.4, same portal) lists the same value. Invoicerr generates no SAF-T (PT) file, so NC is used where the product does need it: the series type an ATCUD is registered under (numbering/atcud.ts#SAFT_PT_DOCUMENT_TYPE_BY_TYPE_ID). (2) the ATCUD, now attached to a Portuguese credit note: see this file's `atcud-required` numbering fact for "credit-note".

provenance.resolutionNote: Recording an expense is a management entry internal to the tool. Portuguese accounting obligations (not explored in depth by this task, outside the requested 'immutability/send/credit-note' scope) bear on the company's own accounting, not on this recording mechanism within the tool.
Deleting a wrongly entered expense; no Portuguese text identified specifically governs the deletion of such an entry before any accounting close.

Recording (or correcting) the fields of a received invoice is an internal management operation — this tool merely records a fact that has already occurred (an invoice already obtained by another means: upload, OCR, manual entry), never technically receiving a fatura over a dedicated Portuguese channel (the SAF-T (PT) is a regime of MONTHLY DECLARATION from the issuer to the AT, not a RECEPTION channel for the buyer). No Portuguese text identified for THIS precise mechanism of entering/correcting a record already in the database.
Marking a received invoice as approved is an internal company review decision; no Portuguese text identified specifically governs this act.

Marking a received invoice as rejected (dispute, supplier error) is an internal company review decision. No Portuguese mechanism for a FORMAL rejection addressed to the tax administration (comparable to Croatian čl. 52) was identified by this task — see correction-routes/data/pt.json's own COUNTERPARTY_OBJECTION (unverified, inconclusive absence).

Recording that this company paid a supplier is an internal bookkeeping entry, the mirror of `invoice.record-payment` above but on the buyer side of a purchase — no Portuguese text identified specifically governs the ACT of recording it in this tool (as opposed to the underlying payment/input-VAT-deduction facts, which exist and produce their own legal effects regardless of whether this screen tracks them). Not independently researched beyond the reasoning already applied to `received-invoice.approve`/`reject` above (2026-09-16).

Deleting a received-invoice record before any approval/rejection decision is a product convenience, of the same nature as `expense.delete` above; no Portuguese text identified governs it. The descriptor already restricts this action to the 'received' status alone.

Saving a purchase-order draft is an internal product operation, unrelated to VAT or invoicing — same reasoning as quote.save-draft above (see its own note for the research conducted on the applicable codes): no text identified that would specifically govern the saving of such a draft. A purchase order, moreover, commits less than a quote does (it does not constitute a sales offer, only a purchase intent from the issuing company itself), which makes the existence of a text targeting it even less likely. Research not specifically redone for this type/action (2026-09-15) — to revisit if a real need requires it.

provenance.sourceText: An electronic signature shall not be denied legal effect and admissibility as evidence in legal proceedings solely on the grounds that it is in an electronic form or that it does not meet the requirements for qualified electronic signatures.

rules.notes: Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 (eIDAS), art. 25 § 1 — the SAME text, at the same verification date (2026-09-04, not the 2026-09-03 of de.json/it.json/pl.json), as quote.send above (see its own note: a European REGULATION applies directly, with no national variant, in every Member State). A purchase order is neither an invoice nor a quote, but is an electronic document like any other with regard to this text: it is this same general regime of non-discrimination of the electronic writing that grounds its sending by email, never a text specific to invoicing or VAT (none exists for this type — see purchase-order.descriptor.ts's own header).

provenance.resolutionNote: Cancelling a purchase order sent to a supplier is a purely commercial act (the company gives up its own order), never the correction of a tax document already transmitted — this is NOT a correction route within the meaning of correction-routes/ (CANCEL_AND_REPLACE and the other routes of that module only concern a tax document ALREADY ISSUED to a third party whose correction the law governs, which a purchase order is not — see purchase-order-actions.ts's own header). The contractual consequences of such a cancellation towards the supplier fall under general contract law, outside the scope of this rule (which only says whether THIS TOOL can record the entry, never whether the cancellation is enforceable against the supplier). No dedicated research conducted for this type/action (2026-09-15) — to revisit if a real need requires it.

Saving a goods-receipt draft is an internal, purely documentary operation (what this company's warehouse recorded as received) — same reasoning as purchase-order.save-draft above: no text identified that would specifically govern the saving of such a draft, this document not being transmitted to anyone (see goods-receipt.descriptor.ts's own header). Research not conducted specifically for this type/action, newly created (2026-09-15) — to revisit if a real need requires it.

Finalizing a goods receipt (status 'recorded') is an internal management act — settling what the warehouse recorded as received against a purchase order, to feed a 3-way matching control that is itself internal to the tool, never transmitted to a third party nor declared to an administration. No text identified that would target this act specifically. Research not conducted specifically for this type/action, newly created (2026-09-15) — to revisit if a real need requires it.

Restricted by the descriptor itself to the 'draft' status (goods-receipt.descriptor.ts): once recorded ('recorded'), a goods receipt is part of the matching trail that a received invoice may already have been compared against, and its deletion is in any case no longer offered by the screen. Before that, deleting a wrongly entered draft is the same internal operation, with no recipient, as purchase-order.save-draft/received-invoice.delete above (see their own notes for the tension, not settled here either, on the retention obligations for a supporting document — LPF art. L. 102 B and L. 102 C, C. com. art. L. 123-22 — which target the RECEIVED INVOICE, never a goods receipt by name). Research not conducted specifically for this type/action, newly created (2026-09-15) — to revisit if a real need requires it.

notes: Portugal (2026-09-04). NINE PRIMARY/OFFICIAL SOURCES READ IN RAW TEXT (direct curl then pdftotext -layout for PDFs, never a fetch-summary): (1) Código do IVA (CIVA), text as served by the Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira (AT) at info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/.../civa_rep/Pages/ivaNN.aspx (one STATIC HTML page per article - classic SharePoint, direct curl without JavaScript) - art. 18.º (rates), art. 29.º (obligation to issue a fatura), art. 36.º (deadline and formalities for faturas, including the mandatory particulars and the electronic-consent regime), art. 53.º (isenção regime for small businesses), art. 78.º (regularizações); (2) Decreto-Lei n.º 28/2019, de 15 de fevereiro (the invoicing regime itself, official 25-page PDF); (3) Portaria n.º 195/2020, de 13 de agosto (ATCUD + código QR, official 3-page PDF, read in full); (4) Portaria n.º 363/2010, de 23 de junho, as republished by Portaria n.º 340/2013 (technical certification requirements for invoicing programs, including the RSA chained signature, official PDF); (5) Portaria n.º 321-A/2007, de 26 de março (foundation of the SAF-T (PT), official PDF, 5 pages - the detailed technical annex is a non-extractable scan, not needed for this task); (6) the raw JSON from the TEDB API (ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/tedb/rest-api/vatSearch, member state 24 = PT) for the Madeira/Azores regional rates (see vat-rates/data/pt.json); (7) eur-lex.europa.eu CELEX:32014R0910 (eIDAS) for quote.send; (8) the AT's own official FAQ, « Outras Obrigações > Séries/ATCUD > Âmbito de Aplicação » (items 4302-4318), https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/apoio_contribuinte/questoes_frequentes/Pages/faqs-00883.aspx, RE-READ on 2026-09-13 (direct curl, HTTP 200, static SharePoint HTML, no JavaScript); (9) Despacho n.º 351/2021-XXII, de 10 de novembro de 2021 (suspension, for the whole of 2022, of the obrigatoriedade of the ATCUD), official signed PDF, https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/informacao_fiscal/legislacao/Despachos_SEAF/Documents/Despacho_SEAAF_351_2021_XXII.pdf, READ on 2026-09-13 (direct curl, HTTP 200, 608,239 bytes, pdftotext -layout). ACCESS METHOD, REUSABLE FINDING FOR THIS BATCH: diariodarepublica.pt (the Portuguese Official Journal) serves ALL of its pages, including the « legislação consolidada », behind an OutSystems React SPA (a massive JS bundle, dr.controller.js, 471 KB, no public REST route identified in this session despite inspecting the bundle) - WORKED AROUND, as documented by this task's brief, via a STATIC official mirror: info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt (the AT's own portal, classic ASP.NET/SharePoint) serves the CIVA article-by-article as static HTML AND hosts, as PDFs downloadable without authentication, the entirety of the relevant supplementary statutes (Decreto-Lei n.º 28/2019, Portarias 195/2020, 363/2010, 340/2013, 22-A/2012, 321-A/2007) under /pt/apoio_ao_contribuinte/Negocios/Faturacao/Regras_de_faturacao/Legislacao and .../Regras_mecanismos_comunicacao/Certificacao_programas - one more SPA-WORKED-AROUND-VIA-STATIC-OFFICIAL-MIRROR precedent for this catalog, alongside riigiteataja/forin.gr/Legilux/legislation.mt/net.jogtar.hu/retsinformation already documented. NO contradiction found with the B2G-routing audit already delivered (2026-09-02: PT « not deliverable » - CIUS-PT not vendorable): this task found NOTHING that would change this verdict; this file therefore models no b2g-routing. Of the 22 rules, 3 are 'legal' at the substantive-fact level (quote.send, invoice.save-draft, invoice.send), plus one real legal basis documented in a note but NOT promoted to the rule level for credit-note.send (same discipline as gr.json/hr.json) - the remaining 18 are honestly 'unverified' with their own resolutionNote each. REVIEWED on 2026-09-13 (invoice.send only): the effective date of the ATCUD obligation was corrected - the regime remained OPTIONAL throughout 2022 (Despacho n.º 351/2021-XXII, alínea e)), such that its actual and applied effective date is 1 January 2023, not the 1 January 2021 that reading art. 8.º of Portaria n.º 195/2020 alone suggested; the structure of the ATCUD (minimum length of the código de validação, obtaining mechanism per series×document-type pair, mandatory precedence over issuance) was documented from sources re-read in the primary source that day; and the distinction between the ATCUD (required regardless of the software's certification status) and the código QR (required only for software certified by the AT, which this product is not) was made explicit. No 'allowed'/'requirement' value changed during this review - only the provenance notes were corrected and enriched.

provenance.sourceText: 1 - O ATCUD, com o formato «ATCUD:CodigodeValidação-NumeroSequencial», deve constar obrigatoriamente em todas as faturas e outros documentos fiscalmente relevantes, emitidos por qualquer dos meios de processamento identificados no artigo 3.º do Decreto-Lei n.º 28/2019, de 15 de fevereiro.

SAF-T (PT) document type FT (Portaria n.º 302/2016, field 4.1.4.8, « "FT" – Fatura, emitida nos termos do artigo 36.º do Código do IVA »): the type its series is registered under, Portaria n.º 195/2020, art. 2.º alínea b).

provenance.sourceText: 1 - O ATCUD, com o formato «ATCUD:CodigodeValidação-NumeroSequencial», deve constar obrigatoriamente em todas as faturas e outros documentos fiscalmente relevantes, emitidos por qualquer dos meios de processamento identificados no artigo 3.º do Decreto-Lei n.º 28/2019, de 15 de fevereiro.

numbering.notes: Issue #497. Portaria n.º 195/2020, art. 4.º n.º 1 puts the ATCUD on « todas as faturas e outros documentos fiscalmente relevantes ». A credit note is a « fatura » for that purpose: Decreto-Lei n.º 28/2019 (the decree whose art. 7.º n.º 3 this Portaria regulates), art. 2.º alínea c), « «Fatura», o documento em papel ou em formato eletrónico que: [...] ii) Constitua um documento retificativo de fatura nos termos legais », and CIVA art. 36.º n.º 6 is the « documentos retificativos de faturas » provision this file's own sequential-number fact quotes. Art. 7.º n.º 3 of the same decree: « Nas faturas e demais documentos fiscalmente relevantes deve constar um código de barras bidimensional (código QR) e um código único de documento ». Both read on the AT's consolidated copy (info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/informacao_fiscal/legislacao/diplomas_legislativos/Documents/Decreto_Lei_28_2019.pdf, « Estado: vigente », amendments listed up to Decreto-Lei n.º 49/2025, 2026-09-28). THE SERIES: Portaria n.º 195/2020, art. 2.º alínea b) makes the document type, « de acordo com as tipologias documentais definidas na estrutura de dados » of the SAF-T (PT), part of what is communicated to obtain a series' validation code, so a credit note's series is its own "NC" series (Portaria n.º 302/2016, field 4.1.4.8, « "NC" – Nota de crédito »), never the invoice's FT one; field 4.1.4.1 also forbids using « o mesmo código interno de tipo de documento em diferentes tipos de documentos ». Produced exactly as for the invoice (actions/atcud-issuance.ts): the credit note's own number format must end in "/{number}", a code must be registered for its predicted series before "send", and the ATCUD is frozen on the document when it is numbered. NOT covered: the QR code (Portaria n.º 195/2020, art. 6.º, binds programs certified by the AT, which Invoicerr is not; the invoice has none either).

constraints.summary: In invoicing software the document number is the document-type code, a space, the series identifier, a slash, then the sequential number within the series. The ATCUD is built from those digits after the slash.

provenance.sourceText: « Nos programas de faturação, esta identificação é composta sequencialmente pelos seguintes elementos: o código interno do tipo de documento, um espaço, o identificador da série do documento, uma barra (/) e o número sequencial desse documento dentro dessa série. Por exemplo, em “FT SERIE/000001”, a série corresponde ao conjunto de carateres “SERIE”. » (AT, FAQ 4310)

constraints.notes: AT FAQ « Séries/ATCUD », https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/apoio_contribuinte/questoes_frequentes/Pages/faqs-00883.aspx, read first-hand (curl, static HTML) on 2026-09-28. Portaria n.º 195/2020, art. 3.º n.º 3 (quoted in numbering/atcud.ts) defines the ATCUD's sequential number as the digits right after the slash, which is why numbering/atcud.ts refuses any other shape.

constraints.summary: A series identifier holds at most 35 characters among unaccented letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen; with the space and slash of the number's structure, those are the only characters a Portuguese number may use.

provenance.sourceText: « O identificador da série do documento não pode conter mais de 35 carateres [...] são aceites os carateres: [A-Z] - Letras maiúsculas (não inclui carateres acentuados nem o “Ç”); [a-z] - Letras minúsculas (não inclui carateres acentuados nem o “ç”); [0-9] - Números de 0 a 9; [._-] - Ponto, sublinhado e traço [...] não é possível utilizar: um separador no início e/ou no fim; dois ou mais separadores consecutivos; séries com identificador iniciado por “AT” » (AT, FAQ 4696)

constraints.notes: AT FAQ « Séries/ATCUD », https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/apoio_contribuinte/questoes_frequentes/Pages/faqs-00883.aspx, read first-hand (curl, static HTML) on 2026-09-28. The 35-character limit and the separator rules bind the series identifier alone, which a whole-number check cannot isolate; the shipped series "A" satisfies all of them.

constraints.summary: SAF-T (PT) holds the document number (InvoiceNo) in at most 60 characters, shaped "TYPE SERIES/NUMBER".

provenance.resolutionNote: Read on 2026-09-28 from a THIRD-PARTY copy of the AT's SAF-T (PT) 1.04_01 schema (github.com/fredericoregateiro/saft, SAFTPT1.04_01.xsd, Windows-1252): <xs:element name="InvoiceNo"> <xs:restriction base="xs:string"> <xs:pattern value="[^ ]+ [^/^ ]+/[0-9]+" /> <xs:minLength value="1" /> <xs:maxLength value="60" />. The AT's own URL for the schema returned 404 in this pass. What would settle it: SAFTPT1.04_01.xsd downloaded from info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt (Portaria n.º 302/2016) and compared byte for byte.

formats.unconstrained: No Portuguese text read in this pass constrains the number of a quote. OPEN QUESTION, not settled here: whether a quote handed to a client is a 'documento de conferência' that Decreto-Lei n.º 28/2019 would require to be issued in its own communicated series, with an ATCUD, was not checked. This product issues no ATCUD on a quote today.
formats.rationale: Unchanged from the product's previous shared default.

"FT" is SAF-T (PT)'s document-type code for a fatura, "A" the series identifier, then the sequential number after the slash, the shape FAQ 4310 describes and the ATCUD needs. The series carries no year: FAQ 4317 and 4318 allow one series and one validation code across several years as long as its numbering never restarts, and this product's counter never restarts. A Portuguese company registers the AT validation code of series "FT A" once, before its first invoice. The product's previous default ("INVOICE-{year}-{number:4}") could not produce an ATCUD at all.

"NC" is SAF-T (PT)'s document-type code for a nota de crédito, in series "A", numbered on its own counter. The same shape as the invoice, so a later ATCUD on the credit note (not issued today, see this file's credit-note `numbering` fact) needs no change of format.

formats.unconstrained: A purchase order is a document this company sends to its own supplier; it is not an invoice, and no Portuguese text read in this pass constrains its number. The supplier's own invoice may quote it (EN 16931 BT-13), which is that supplier's concern, not this number's format.
formats.rationale: Unchanged from the product's previous shared default.

formats.unconstrained: A goods receipt is an internal record of what arrived; it is never sent to a tax authority or a buyer, and no Portuguese text read in this pass constrains its number.
formats.rationale: Unchanged from the product's previous shared default.

runningSeries.summary: A series this company already started, with its AT validation code, is kept as it is: the AT forbids restarting the numbering of a series already in use, and a series may run across years as long as its numbering never restarts.

provenance.sourceText: « Não é possível reiniciar a numeração sequencial de uma série já utilizada. [...] A mesma série e respetivo código de validação só pode ser utilizada em mais do que um ano (plurianual) desde que seja garantida a numeração sequencial ao longo dos vários anos, sem ser reiniciada. » (AT, FAQ 4318) ; « uma série e respetivo código de validação pode ser utilizada durante mais do que um ano, desde que seja mantida a respetiva numeração sequencial ao longo da sua utilização. » (AT, FAQ 4317)

runningSeries.onViolation: A running series without the "TYPE SERIES/NUMBER" shape cannot carry an ATCUD. The country format then applies from the next number, which starts a NEW series ("FT A" or "NC A"): its AT validation code must be registered before the first document in it (FAQ 4308). The counter is not reset, so the new series starts at the next number rather than at 1; the starting number is declared when the series is communicated to the AT.
runningSeries.notes: AT FAQ « Séries/ATCUD », https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/apoio_contribuinte/questoes_frequentes/Pages/faqs-00883.aspx, read first-hand (curl, static HTML) on 2026-09-28. NOT READ, would confirm the last sentence: the AT's series-communication form or webservice specification, for the field that declares a new series' first sequential number.
